provenance.method: Independent semantic review of all eight labels, ordered prose behavior then completeness then override then composite; local standard-library structural checks of all evidence/citation mappings and exact excerpts. Supplied expectations were compared after derivation.
provenance.limitations: Procedural separate-agent isolation, not a technical access-control guarantee, expert human adjudication, evaluator execution, or runtime holdout. Frozen source hashes and commit are recorded from the allowed freeze file, not independently verified through prohibited source/Git reads.
